provenance: synthetic teaching cases, not runtime observations
capability: dedicated synthetic control-plane snapshot/restore plus independent application-data backup

cases.task: Assign API objects and persistent marker bytes to their backup sources.
cases.expected: Two distinct sources and restore checks.

cases.task: Hash the fixed marker and compare it with a changed marker.
cases.expected: Equal bytes match; changed bytes fail the reference digest.

cases.task: State why the immutable marker is simpler than a live transactional database.
cases.expected: No claim of database-consistent backup or log replay.

cases.task: Accept API objects but reject the wrong data hash in the supplied trace.
cases.expected: Overall recovery fails until both API and data gates pass.

cases.task: Classify private snapshots, credentials and public receipt fields.
cases.expected: No snapshots or secrets in portable progress; only bounded metadata and synthetic checksums.

cases.task: Document the dedicated source/destination ownership and eventual disposal.
cases.expected: No restore into an ambient or shared target; exact owned cleanup.
